excerpts:
# PhotoShelter Announces New CEO: Andrew Fingerman
## Co-Founder Allen Murabayashi shifts to Chairman of the Board
**New York, NY, May 2, 2012** - PhotoShelter ( http://www.photoshelter.com ), PhotoShelter, the leader in photography portfolio websites, sales, marketing and archiving tools announced today that Andrew Fingerman will be named the company’s new Chief Executive Officer.
Andrew replaces PhotoShelter Co-Founder Allen Murabayashi who has led the company as CEO since its inception in 2005.

...

Fingerman has served as PhotoShelter’s Vice President of Marketing for 4.5 years. He’s been responsible for the evolution of the PhotoShelter brand and the continuous growth of PhotoShelter customer base, which now stands at 74,000 photographers.

...

“We’re fortunate to have an experienced and respected leader in Andrew -- someone who marries smart business savvy with a deep passion for photography, innovation, and strengthening our relationships with photographers.”

...

### About PhotoShelter
More than 80,000 professional photographers and 70 leading brands trust and rely on PhotoShelter to do just that every day, with over 200 million of their image assets. To learn more, visit http://www.photoshelter.com .
